description: This file sets up initial data records for agricultural analysis criteria and item groups in an ERP system, using the Frappe framework.

methods.name: setup_agriculture
methods.description: Checks if 'Agriculture Analysis Criteria' exist; if not, calls create_agriculture_data to initialize data.

methods.name: create_agriculture_data
methods.description: Creates and inserts predefined records for item groups and analysis criteria related to agriculture.
